directives.title: Challenge £44.4K paid during active Companies House breaches
directives.evidence: 2 suppliers received payments while in breach of Companies Act — including 0 critical and 0 high severity. Temporally verified against payment dates.
directives.notes: Due-diligence control failure. Request supplier screening process review.

directives.title: Investigate £85.8K likely duplicate payments
directives.evidence: 31 high-confidence duplicate groups with same supplier, amount, date and reference (3+ copies) (after filtering 29667 CSV republication artifacts)
directives.notes: Request duplicate payment recovery report from s151 officer.

directives.title: Scrutinise £2.6M medium-confidence duplicate payments
directives.notes: Sample audit of top 50 groups by value — different references may be legitimate.

directives.title: Challenge £313.1M suspected split payments
directives.evidence: 862 instances of 3+ payments just below approval thresholds in the same week
directives.notes: Classic indicator of bypassed procurement controls. FOI procurement authorisation records.

directives.title: FOI: round-number payments over £5K (£451.5M)
directives.evidence: 1038 exact round-number payments over £5,000 — may indicate estimates rather than invoiced amounts
directives.notes: Round figures can indicate estimates rather than invoiced amounts. FOI invoice breakdown for top 20.

directives.title: Question 3.6x March year-end spending spike
directives.evidence: Balance Sheet spent 3.6x their monthly average in March (£71.1M above normal). Note: UK councils operate on April–March fiscal years, so elevated March spending is common as departments finalise annual budgets. Spikes above 3x warrant further scrutiny.
directives.notes: Request written explanation from s151 officer. Compare with peer pattern.

directives.title: Review 15 rapid-payment suppliers (<14-day cadence)
directives.evidence: 15 suppliers receive payments every <14 days on average. Top: Icars Burton Upon Trent Ltd (1.0 day avg, 17 payments, £30.0K)
directives.notes: Suggests framework contract lacking consolidation OR pass-through arrangement. Request contract register for top 5.

directives.title: Review Benford's Law first-digit distribution (χ²=33591.47)
directives.evidence: Significant deviation from Benford's Law (p < 0.001). Digit 3 deviates 6.9% from expected distribution across 422,203 transactions. Note: with 422,203 transactions, chi-squared tests are highly sensitive — the 6.9% max digit deviation is the more practical measure of anomaly.
directives.notes: Statistical noise on large samples; compare with other councils before escalating.

directives.title: Investigate Benford's 2nd-digit anomaly (χ²=5212.99)
directives.evidence: Second-digit distribution across 422,203 transactions shows p < 0.001 (highly significant). Digit 3 deviates 1.8% from Nigrini's expected distribution. Second-digit tests are more discriminating than first-digit for detecting round-number bias and fabricated invoices.
directives.notes: Second-digit tests are more discriminating than first-digit for round-number bias and fabricated invoices.

directives.title: Scrutinise 5 weak-competition contracts
directives.evidence: 5 contracts show signs of limited competition (short tender periods or rapid award). Top: Award of contract for the supply of Desktop Comput (£1.3M)
directives.notes: FOI tender evaluation reports. Question at Scrutiny why restricted tender was used.

directives.title: Request internal audit action plan on all 10 DOGE findings
directives.notes: Formal letter to Chief Internal Auditor requesting a written action plan covering all DOGE findings. Request named owners, committed timescales, and reporting back to Audit Committee.
